result.title: Show accurate overall work progress
result.problem: The main progress bar reaches 100% from passing checks even when implementation, required reviews, or other completion tasks remain unfinished.
result.objective: See how much required work is complete without mistaking passing checks for finished work.

suggestedSlices.title: Count all completion tasks in the progress bar
acceptance: Passing checks cannot produce 100% while any required implementation, review, permission, deferred obligation, screenshot, workflow output, or turn-closure task remains incomplete.

The progress count covers the applicable completion checklist, counts grouped tasks consistently, avoids counting the same diagnostic twice, and reaches 100% only when the shared completion gate allows completion.
Overview and spec details show consistent completion progress; evidence counts stay separate, missing scope is indeterminate, and historical completion stays distinct from current rechecking.
